characters.continuity: Kirby's Return to Dream Land (Wii, 2011) and Return to Dream Land Deluxe
characters.summary: Ultra Sword is a temporary Super Ability in which Kirby swings a sword far larger than himself; it defeats any common enemy or mid-boss in one hit and destroys terrain marked with large stars.

mechanisms: Not established by the sources opened (no invulnerability while swinging is documented)

weaknesses: A boss can forcefully dispel the Super Ability, returning Kirby to his normal state
limitations: Runs on a timer; Kirby loses it when the timer expires, when he is defeated, exits the stage, or enters a rift to Another Dimension
Only available in specific areas where a Super Blade Knight appears
characters.formDifferences: Kirby himself is not enlarged; he gains a temporary, enormous sword that one-shots common enemies and mid-bosses and destroys star-marked terrain and obstacles.

sources.supports: Ultra Sword is obtained from a Super Blade Knight, defeats any common enemy or mid-boss in one hit, destroys star-marked terrain, and delivers the finishing blows against Grand Doomer and Magolor.
Super Abilities run on a timer and are lost on defeat, on leaving the stage, on entering Another Dimension, or when a boss dispels them.

feats.claim: Defeats any common enemy or mid-boss in one hit
Destroys terrain and obstacles marked with large stars; Deluxe flavor text says it 'destroys everything in its path, even the ground'
feats.citation: Kirby's Return to Dream Land / Deluxe

notableResults.note: Ultra Sword is the last Super Ability to appear and delivers the finishing blow once the boss's shield is broken by Super Abilities.
Ultra Sword, grown even larger for this fight, delivers the finishing blow once Magolor's shield is broken.

conditional.dependsOn: Inhaling or defeating a Super Blade Knight in specific areas; lost when the Super Ability timer runs out

unknowns: Exact duration of the Super Ability timer.

Removed by review: tag giant-sized (Kirby is not enlarged; only the sword is, so the size ruling does not apply); result: win vs Landia (the source does not mention Landia; corrected to Grand Doomer and Magolor); defense: invincibility frames during the swing (not documented); mobility: restricted movement while holding the sword (not documented); technique names 'Multi-directional Giant Swing' and 'Colossal Sword Slash' (no such moves listed).
Earlier keyword pass removed a pillar/boss-bisecting feat; not restored (pillars not mentioned).

characters.continuity: Sonic the Hedgehog video game series (main games)
characters.summary: Knuckles is a strong echidna who smashes boulders and breaks through solid ground with his fists, lifts objects many times his size, glides long distances, climbs walls and can swim.

techniques: Punches that smash boulders and break through solid ground

mechanisms: Not established by the sources opened

weaknesses: Gullible and rash, especially when angered; repeatedly tricked by Doctor Robotnik

sources.supports: Lifts objects many times his size, smashes boulders and breaks through ground, glides, climbs, swims, rolls to attack; gullible and tricked by Robotnik; named game fights with Sonic.
Superhuman strength, digging and wall-scaling with his clawed fists, gliding with his dreadlocks; gullible and short-tempered.

feats.claim: Lifts objects many times his size and weight
Smashes boulders and breaks through solid ground with his fists

notableResults.note: Believing Sonic's two Chaos Emeralds were Master Emerald shards, Knuckles attacked him and knocked them out of his hands; Eggman then stole them.

campaignTags.claim: Glides long distances (Wikipedia; Sonic Stadium: glides using his dreadlocks)
'Unlike Sonic, Knuckles is able to swim.'

unknowns: Maximum striking strength without Chaos Emeralds; height not stated (giant-sized not applicable).

Removed by review (not supported by the sources opened): defense: high durability, quick recovery; limitation: relies entirely on close-quarters combat; feat: smashing thick metal plating (boulders and ground are supported, metal is not); result vs Sonic in Sonic 3 (fights occur but no outcome is stated).

characters.continuity: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles (1994), its only game appearance
characters.summary: Hyper Knuckles is Knuckles' super form, attained with the seven Super Emeralds and fifty rings; he is virtually invulnerable while it lasts, and gliding into a wall triggers a shock wave that destroys every enemy on screen.

techniques: Gliding Shock Wave Attack (glide into a wall to cause a screen-wide earthquake)

mechanisms: Virtually invulnerable while the transformation lasts

weaknesses: Not established by the sources opened
limitations: Rings drain during the form; he reverts to normal when they run out
The screen-clearing effect ignores off-screen objects, bosses and enemies that take multiple hits
characters.formDifferences: Adds near-invulnerability and the Gliding Shock Wave Attack to base Knuckles; requires the seven Super Emeralds and at least fifty rings and lasts only while rings remain.

sources.supports: CC-BY-SA copy of the Sonic Wiki article: attained with seven Super Emeralds and fifty rings, virtually invulnerable, reverts when out of rings, Gliding Shock Wave Attack destroys all enemies on screen.
Code analysis of Sonic 3 & Knuckles: the Hyper screen-clear ignores off-screen objects, bosses and multi-hit enemies.
Using the Super Emeralds allows Knuckles to transform into Hyper Knuckles.

feats.claim: Gliding into a wall causes an earthquake that destroys all enemies on the screen

conditional.dependsOn: Seven Super Emeralds and at least fifty rings; ends when rings run out

campaignTags.claim: Keeps Knuckles' glide; the Gliding Shock Wave Attack is performed by gliding into a wall

unknowns: Exact duration of the form for a given ring count.

Removed by review (not supported by the sources opened): technique 'Flash Dash' / blinding speed and afterimages; super-speed; enhanced flight (he glides, flight is not documented, so no flight tag); result vs Robotnik's forces (no named fight).

characters.continuity: God of War video game series (Greek saga 2005–2010 and Norse saga 2018–2022)
characters.summary: Kratos is a Spartan warrior turned god-slayer with superhuman strength who fights with chained blades and the Leviathan Axe, and in the Greek saga wields god-granted lightning, Medusa's head and the Souls of Hades; he has killed Ares, Poseidon, Cronos and Zeus.

techniques: Summoning the Souls of Hades (Greek saga)

mechanisms: Not established by the sources opened

weaknesses: His god-level power can be stripped or drained: Zeus tricked him into pouring it into the Blade of Olympus, rendering him mortal, and Helios and Athena stripped his strength and equipment
mobility: Underwater breathing via Poseidon's Trident (Greek saga)
limitations: The Leviathan Axe's frost damage is useless in Helheim, forcing a switch to the Blades of Chaos
Without the power of the gods he was mortally injured fighting the Colossus

sources.supports: Weapons (Blades of Chaos, Leviathan Axe, Blade of Olympus), the Helheim limitation, and his kills of Ares, Zeus, Poseidon, Gaia, Baldur, Magni and Modi, and Odin's defeat.
Superhuman strength, god-granted lightning, Medusa's head, Souls of Hades, Poseidon's Trident, and the deaths of Ares, Poseidon and Cronos.

feats.claim: Killed Poseidon by gouging out his eyes and breaking his neck
Killed his grandfather, the Titan Cronos, by stabbing him in the forehead with the Blade of Olympus

notableResults.note: Stabbed Ares through the heart with the Blade of the Gods after finding Pandora's Box, then became god of war.
Zeus tricked him into pouring his godly powers into the Blade of Olympus, then used it to kill him.
Gouged out his eyes and broke his neck.
Killed Baldur after Baldur tried to kill Freya.
Team result: Kratos, Atreus, Mímir and Freya defeated him as Asgard fell.

campaignTags.claim: In the Greek saga he hurls god-granted lightning, petrifies with Medusa's head and calls on the Souls of Hades
Poseidon's Trident gives him the power to breathe underwater

unknowns: Durability limits; the sources opened do not document specific defensive feats.
